sections.text: ...THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER MUCH OF THE SOUTHERN AND CENTRAL PLAINS...

sections.title: OK/TX
sections.text: RADAR LOOPS SHOW A LARGE CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS THAT HAS DEVELOPED IN THE PAST FEW HOURS OVER THE TX PANHANDLE. THIS ACTIVITY APPEARS TO BE ASSOCIATED WITH A SHORTWAVE TROUGH SUGGESTED ON WATER VAPOR IMAGERY ALONG THE TX/NM BORDER. AS THIS FEATURE TRACKS EASTWARD...THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY WILL CONTINUE AND BECOME MORE INTENSE...LEADING TO A REGION OF ENHANCED SEVERE WEATHER RISK TODAY OVER PARTS OF SOUTHERN OK AND NORTH TX. LATEST SURFACE ANALYSIS SHOWS A SUBTLE REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM OVERNIGHT CONVECTION OVER NORTH TX. VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS THAT CLEARING IS OCCURRING RATHER RAPIDLY ON THE NORTH SIDE OF THE BOUNDARY...WITH GUSTY SURFACE WINDS HELPING TO TRANSPORT RICH MOISTURE BACK TO THE NORTHWEST. BY MID AFTERNOON...PARTS OF SOUTHWEST OK AND WESTERN NORTH TX SHOULD BECOME STRONGLY UNSTABLE WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE MID-UPPER 60S AND MLCAPE VALUES OF 2500-3000 J/KG. CURRENT CONVECTION AND ASSOCIATED OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES MAY COMPLICATE STORM-MODE...BUT POTENTIAL EXISTS FOR DISCRETE SUPERCELL DEVELOPMENT WITH THE RISK OF VERY LARGE HAIL. LOW LEVEL WINDS ARE NOT FORECAST TO BE PARTICULARLY STRONG...BUT STEEP LAPSE RATES AND AMPLE CAPE COUPLED WITH MESOSCALE ENHANCEMENT TO

sections.title: EASTERN CO
sections.text: ISOLATED TO SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO FORM THIS AFTERNOON OVER THE PLAINS OF EASTERN CO...MAINLY FROM THE PALMER RIDGE SOUTHWARD. DEWPOINTS IN THE 50S...BACKED LOW LEVEL WINDS...AND SUFFICIENT FLOW ALOFT WILL PROMOTE ROTATING STORMS CAPABLE OF HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. AN ISOLATED TORNADO CANNOT BE RULED OUT.

sections.title: UPPER MIDWEST INTO CENTRAL PLAINS
sections.text: SCATTERED SHOWERS AND THUNDERSTORMS WILL DEVELOP LATER TODAY ALONG AND EAST OF A SURFACE COLD FRONT EXTENDING FROM MN INTO CENTRAL KS. A FEW OF THE CLUSTERS OF STORMS MAY POSE A RISK OF HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS...BUT THE OVERALL CONVECTIVE ORGANIZATION MAY BE LIMITED BY MARGINAL EFFECTIVE SHEAR VALUES. NEVERTHELESS...HAVE OPTED TO INCLUDE MORE OF IA/MO IN SLIGHT RISK. ..HART/JEWELL.. 05/07/2015

sections.title: THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS FROM SWRN TX TO NWRN WI
sections.text: ...SUMMARY... ISOLATED TO SCATTERED SEVERE STORMS ARE POSSIBLE FROM THE UPPER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY TO THE SOUTHERN GREAT PLAINS...MAINLY THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. THE MAIN THREAT AREA FOR VERY LARGE HAIL AND A FEW TORNADOES WILL BE ACROSS NORTH TEXAS AND SOUTHERN OKLAHOMA.

sections.title: RED RIVER REGION OF SRN PLAINS
sections.text: SRN HIGH PLAINS COMPLEX OF TSTMS IS GRADUALLY EXPANDING ACROSS SWRN OK/NWRN TX. THIS ACTIVITY IS EVOLVING WITHIN ZONE OF WEAK LOW-LEVEL WARM ADVECTION...POSSIBLY AIDED BY WEAK LOW-LATITUDE DISTURBANCE THAT EJECTED ACROSS SRN NM DURING THE EARLY MORNING HOURS. WITHIN THIS EXPANDING COMPLEX OF STORMS...MCV APPEARS TO BE FORMING OVER SRN WASHITA/KIOWA COUNTY REGION OF OK. LATEST HRRR GUIDANCE APPEARS TO HANDLE THIS EVOLVING MCS WELL WITH SUBSEQUENT MOVEMENT ESEWD ALONG THE RED RIVER. ADDITIONALLY...MULTIPLE SUPERCELLS HAVE EVOLVED ALONG THE SERN FLANK OF THIS COMPLEX AS THEY LIFT NEWD INTO LEADING EDGE OF SURGING MCS. GREATEST RISK FOR LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE AHEAD OF THIS COMPLEX. ELSEWHERE...ONLY MINOR ADJUSTMENTS WERE MADE TO INCLUDE MRGL SEVERE THREAT ALONG DRY LINE ACROSS SWRN TX. ..DARROW.. 05/07/2015 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1129 AM CDT THU MAY 07 2015/

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT FOR MAINLY LARGE HAIL AND POSSIBLY STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL PERSIST NEXT COUPLE HOURS FROM A PORTION OF THE TX PANHANDLE INTO NWRN TX. THOUGH A WW IS POSSIBLE...THREAT FROM THESE INITIAL STORMS MAY NOT BE SUFFICIENT FOR A WW ISSUANCE AT THIS TIME. HOWEVER...THE SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE BY EARLY AFTERNOON FROM NWRN TX INTO SWRN OK...A WHICH TIME A WW MIGHT BE NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EARLY THIS MORNING A CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY EXTENDS ACROSS NRN TX INTO NWRN TX. SOUTH OF THIS BOUNDARY THE NEAR SFC LAYER IS VERY MOIST WITH UPPER 60S DEWPOINTS OVER CNTRL TX AND MID 60S OVER WRN TX GENERALLY SOUTH OF LUBBOCK. STORMS THAT ARE CURRENTLY DEVELOPING OVER WRN TX APPEAR TO BE IN RESPONSE TO ZONE OF ASCENT ACCOMPANYING A LOW AMPLITUDE SHORTWAVE TROUGH EVIDENT ON WV IMAGERY. THESE STORMS APPEAR POORLY ORGANIZED AND ELEVATED ABOVE A STABLE SFC LAYER...BUT EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR FROM 30-40 KT IS SUFFICIENT FOR SOME OF THE STORMS TO ACQUIRE MID-LEVEL UPDRAFT ROTATION. STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...MODERATE INSTABILITY AND POTENTIAL FOR UPDRAFT ROTATION WILL SUPPORT THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL WITH SOME OF THIS INITIAL ACTIVITY. WITH TIME THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY WILL WEAKEN...AND RICHER MOISTURE WILL ADVECT INTO NWRN TX AND SWRN OK WHICH /IN ADDITION TO DIABATIC HEATING/ WILL SUPPORT DESTABILIZATION. IT IS POSSIBLE THAT SOME OF THE SRN MOST STORMS OVER WRN TX MIGHT PERSIST AND INTENSIFY LATER THIS MORNING INTO THE AFTERNOON AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER RECOVERS. STORMS THAT PERSIST AND REDEVELOP THIS AFTERNOON IN VICINITY OF THIS BOUNDARY WILL PROMOTE A GREATER SEVERE THREAT INCLUDING SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF VERY LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING WIND AND A FEW TORNADOES.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO BECOME BETTER ORGANIZED AND INCREASE IN INTENSITY FROM SRN OK THROUGH NRN TX THIS AFTERNOON. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND WILL BE THE MAIN THREATS...BUT A FEW TORNADOES CANNOT BE RULED OUT. WW WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED SOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STORMS HAVE LARGELY EVOLVED INTO AN MCS FROM NWRN TX INTO SWRN OK AND IS MOVING SLOWLY EWD. STORM EMBEDDED WITHIN LEADING EDGE OF MCS OVER SWRN OK IS BEGINNING TO SHOW UPDRAFT ROTATION. THE SFC LAYER DOWNSTREAM FROM THIS ACTIVITY IS UNDERGOING RAPID RECOVERY AS AN OLD OUTFLOW BOUNDARY WEAKENS AND LIFTS NWD...ALLOWING RICHER /UPPER 60S F DEWPOINTS/ TO ADVECT THROUGH NRN TX AND SRN OK. MIXED CONVECTIVE MODE WITHIN THE MCS AND GENERALLY MODEST LOW-LEVEL SHEAR LOWERS CONFIDENCE IN A MORE SUBSTANTIAL TORNADO THREAT. NEVERTHELESS...DEEP SHEAR FROM 40-50 KT...A MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER AND MODERATE INSTABILITY WILL SUPPORT EMBEDDED ORGANIZED STRUCTURES WITHIN THE MCS INCLUDING SUPERCELLS AND BOWING SEGMENTS. MOREOVER A FEW DISCRETE STORMS MIGHT ALSO DEVELOP SEPARATE FROM THE MCS. AS THESE STORMS INTERACT WITH THE RESIDUAL BOUNDARY...ISOLATED TORNADOES WILL BE POSSIBLE DESPITE RELATIVELY SMALL AMBIENT HODOGRAPHS. OTHERWISE...LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND WILL THE MAIN THREATS AS THIS ACTIVITY DEVELOPS EWD THIS AFTERNOON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED SEVERE STORMS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS ARE LIKELY THROUGH AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY CONTINUES TO RAPIDLY ARC NWD ACROSS THE TX/OK PANHANDLES AND INTO SRN KS EMANATING FROM THE MCS OVER SWRN OK. AREAS OF HEATING HAVE HELPED THE ANTECEDENT AIR MASS DESTABILIZE WITH DEWPOINTS RISING INTO THE 60S AS A RESULT OF BOUNDARY LAYER MIXING. SHEAR PROFILES ARE MARGINAL FOR LONG-LIVED/ORGANIZED SEVERE STORMS. HOWEVER...MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE QUITE STEEP AND POCKETS OF HEATING WILL CONTINUE TO AID UPDRAFT INTENSITY. THE RESULT WILL BE ISOLATED LARGE HAIL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A FEW SEVERE STORMS ARE LIKELY WITH LARGE HAIL THE MAIN THREAT. A WEAK/BRIEF TORNADO CANNOT BE RULED OUT ACROSS THE HIGHER ELEVATIONS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SMALL STORMS ARE FORMING OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OVER SERN CO WITH AMPLE INSTABILITY AND MOISTURE FOR HAIL GIVEN COOL PROFILES ALOFT. HODOGRAPH LENGTH IS BEING AUGMENTED BY WEAK ELY LOW-LEVEL WINDS WHICH SHOULD ALSO HELP STORMS MOVE/PROPAGATE IN AN ELY DIRECTION. CONTINUED HEATING SHOULD ALLOW STORMS TO SURVIVE INTO THE LOWER ELEVATIONS WITH A CONTINUED HAIL THREAT. ERN EXTENT OF THE THREAT WILL BE LIMITED BY THE NWWD SURGING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY INTO SWRN KS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP EWD INTO SRN OK AND NCNTRL TX THIS EVENING. A NEW WW WILL PROBABLY BE NEEDED WITHIN THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO. PRIMARY THREATS WILL BE LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND...BUT A COUPLE TORNADOES CANNOT BE RULED OUT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MCS FROM WRN OK SWWD THROUGH NWRN TX IS MOVING GENERALLY EWD AT 15 TO 20 KT. OTHER DISCRETE CELLS ARE FORMING IN NCNTRL TX AHEAD OF THE LINE. OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS INDICATES THE ATMOSPHERE HAS BECOME MODERATELY TO STRONGLY UNSTABLE WITH 2000-3000 J/KG MLCAPE AND MINIMAL CAP REMAINING. VWP DATA SHOW LOW-LEVEL SHEAR IS WEAK WITH SMALL HODOGRAPHS. HOWEVER...40-50 KT SHEAR THROUGH A DEEP LAYER IS SUPPORTIVE OF SUPERCELLS AND STORM ORGANIZATION. THE STORMS WITHIN THE LINE WILL CONTINUE TO FORWARD PROPAGATE...AND SOME OF THE DISCRETE CELLS IN WARM SECTOR WILL LIKELY EVOLVE INTO SUPERCELLS. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND WILL REMAIN THE PRIMARY THREATS WITH THE STRONGER STORMS INTO THE EARLY EVENING. SOME INCREASE IN THE LLJ WILL OCCUR THIS EVENING WHICH WILL ENHANCE 0-1 KM HODOGRAPHS AND SUPPORT AT LEAST A SMALL WINDOW FOR A FEW TORNADOES.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT MAY DEVELOP ACROSS THE LOW ROLLING PLAINS SEWD INTO WCNTRL TX FROM LATE THIS AFTERNOON THROUGH EARLY THIS EVENING. HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE MORE INTENSE CORES. WW ISSUANCE APPEARS UNLIKELY DUE TO THE ISOLATED NATURE OF THE THREAT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A DRYLINE ACROSS WEST TX AND A WELL-DEFINED OUTFLOW BOUNDARY EXTENDING EWD ACROSS THE LOW ROLLING PLAINS NEWD TO NEAR THE RED RIVER. A SHORT LINE SEGMENT IS DEVELOPING ALONG THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY TO THE SOUTHEAST OF LUBBOCK. AN AXIS OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE IS ANALYZED JUST TO THE SOUTH OF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY WHERE SFC DEWPOINTS ARE IN THE MID TO UPPER 60S F. THIS IS CONTRIBUTING TO MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY WITH MLCAPE VALUES ESTIMATED IN THE 2000 TO 3000 J/KG RANGE. IN ADDITION...THE WSR-88D VWP AT ABILENE SHOWS GRADUAL VEERING WITH HEIGHT BELOW 3 KM AND AMPLE FLOW IN THE MID-LEVELS RESULTING IN 0-6 KM SHEAR OF 35 TO 40 KT. THIS SHOULD SUPPORT SEVERE THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT AS A LINE MOVES SEWD ALONG THE INSTABILITY AXIS THROUGH EARLY THIS EVENING. ALTHOUGH SUPERCELLS WILL BE POSSIBLE...THE CURRENT STORM MODE IS LINEAR. THIS MAY RESULT IN AN ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE THREAT ESPECIALLY IF A COLD POOL CAN DEVELOP. THE INSTABILITY COUPLED WITH STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES OF 7.5 TO 8.0 C/KM MAY ALSO RESULT IN HAIL WITH THE STRONGER CORES.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LOCAL RISK FOR HAIL AND GUSTY/DAMAGING WINDS CONTINUES WITH ISOLATED STORMS ACROSS THE WW AREA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST RADAR LOOP SHOWS TWO SEPARATE CLUSTERS OF STORMS ONGOING IN/NEAR THE WW AREA ATTM -- ONE OVER E CENTRAL CO INVOF THE PALMER RIDGE AND A SECOND OVER SERN PORTIONS OF THE WW AND INTO ADJACENT PARTS OF SWRN KS AND WRN PARTS OF THE OK PANHANDLE. THE STORMS ARE ONGOING IN A MODESTLY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT /MIXED-LAYER CAPE AOB 1000 J/KG PER OBJECTIVE ANALYSES/...AND MODEST SHEAR /0-6 KM BULK SHEAR AROUND 35 KT/. AS SUCH...WITH SOME DECREASE IN CAPE WITH TIME THIS EVENING AND A FORECAST/GRADUAL WEAKENING OF THE FLOW FIELD ALOFT...AN EVENTUAL/SLOW DIMINISHING TREND WILL LIKELY PRESENT ITSELF IN TERMS OF STORM ORGANIZATION/SEVERITY. IN THE MEAN TIME...RISK FOR MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL AND/OR WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGEST STORMS. ..GOSS.. 05/07/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THREAT WILL LIKELY CONTINUE FOR SEVERAL MORE HOURS AS A LINE OF STORMS MOVES EWD INTO SE OK AND ACROSS NORTH TX. LARGE HAIL...WIND DAMAGE AND AN ISOLATED TORNADO THREAT MAY OCCUR WITH THE STRONGER CELLS AS AN MCS CONTINUES TO ORGANIZE EARLY THIS EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A WELL-DEFINED OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM NW TX EXTENDING NNEWD INTO CNTRL OK...ALONG WHICH A LINE OF STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS IS ONGOING. AHEAD OF THE LINE...SFC DEWPOINTS ACROSS ECNTRL OK AND NE TX ARE IN THE UPPER 60S AND LOWER 70S F...CONTRIBUTING TO MLCAPE ESTIMATED IN THE 1500 TO 2500 J/KG RANGE. IN ADDITION...THE FORT WORTH WSR-88D VWP SHOWS VEERING WINDS WITH HEIGHT IN THE LOWEST 1 KM AND AMPLE SPEED SHEAR MAINLY ABOVE 3 KM. THIS IS CREATING STRONG DEEP LAYER SHEAR NEAR 60 KT WHICH WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR SEVERE STORMS. THE SEVERE THREAT SHOULD BE CONCENTRATED FROM JUST NORTH OF FORT WORTH NWD INTO ECNTRL OK WHERE LARGE-SCALE ASCENT IS STRONGER DUE TO THE PRESENCE OF A SUBTLE SHORTWAVE TROUGH EVIDENT ON WATER VAPOR IMAGERY. ALTHOUGH WIND DAMAGE WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH A LINE OF STORMS NEAR AND TO THE NORTH OF THE RED RIVER...SUPERCELLS WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP JUST TO THE NORTH OF FORTH WORTH. THESE ROTATING STORMS SHOULD BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING LARGE HAIL AND POSSIBLY A TORNADO OR TWO EARLY THIS EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A THREAT FOR WIND DAMAGE AND HAIL WILL LIKELY CONTINUE FOR SEVERAL MORE HOURS. A BRIEF TORNADO WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE OVER THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO. A LOCAL EXTENSION MAY BE NEEDED TO THE EAST OF WW 141.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A NEARLY CONTINUOUS LINE OF STORMS HAS DEVELOPED FROM NEAR THE RED RIVER SWWD TO JUST SOUTH OF ABILENE. A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIRMASS IS LOCATED AHEAD OF THE LINE WITH MESOANALYSIS DATA SHOWING MLCAPE APPROACHING 2000 J/KG. IN ADDITION...THE FORT WORTH WSR-88D VWP SHOWS VEERING WINDS WITH HEIGHT BELOW 3 KM AND 30 KT OF FLOW JUST ABOVE THE SFC. THIS WIND PROFILE WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR SEVERE STORMS AS A MCS CONTINUES TO ORGANIZE THIS EVENING. STORM MODE HAS TRANSITIONED FROM DISCRETE TO LINEAR OVER THE LAST COUPLE OF HOURS SUGGESTING THE WIND DAMAGE THREAT HAS INCREASED WITH THE LINE. AS THE LINE MOVES THROUGH THE DALLAS/FORT WORTH METRO AND THROUGH COMMUNITIES NWD TO THE RED RIVER...A WIND DAMAGE THREAT SHOULD EXIST ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF THE LINE. THE GREATEST WIND DAMAGE POTENTIAL SHOULD BE ASSOCIATED WITH BOWING SEGMENTS EMBEDDED IN THE LINE. IN ADDITION TO THE WIND DAMAGE THREAT...HAIL AND A BRIEF TORNADO WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE THREAT ONGOING IN THE ERN AND SRN PART OF WW 141 IS EXPECTED TO BECOME MORE ISOLATED TONIGHT. HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS. WW ISSUANCE IS NOT EXPECTED TO THE EAST OF WW 141 BUT A LOCAL EXTENSION COULD BE NECESSARY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A COMPLEX LINEAR MCS IS ONGOING ACROSS ERN OK EXTENDING SWWD INTO NORTH AND CNTRL TX...LOCATED ALONG THE NWRN EDGE OF A CORRIDOR OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE. SFC DEWPOINTS TO THE EAST OF THE MCS ARE IN THE UPPER 60S AND LOWER 70S FROM NEAR THE RED RIVER SWWD INTO THE NRN TX HILL COUNTRY WHERE MLCAPE IS ESTIMATED FROM 1500 TO 2000 J/KG. THE INSTABILITY COMBINED WITH A STRENGTHENING LOW-LEVEL JET OVER EAST TX AND SE OK WILL HELP TO KEEP THE MCS GOING TONIGHT. STRONG WIND GUSTS AND HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE BETTER ORGANIZED PARTS OF THE LINE. HOWEVER...INSTABILITY SHOULD GRADUALLY DECREASE OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS RESULTING IN A GENERAL DOWNTREND IN THE SEVERE THREAT.
